scenarios.name: mixed-size tenant fairness
scenarios.requirement: One hot tenant cannot consume every scheduler candidate slot.
scenarios.acceptance: The fair scan returns at most one candidate per tenant.

scenarios.name: concurrent duplicate dispatch
scenarios.requirement: Concurrent dispatchers cannot execute the same event twice.
scenarios.acceptance: Only one execution is admitted.

scenarios.name: duplicate provider completion
scenarios.requirement: An identical callback replay is idempotent and a conflicting replay fails closed.
scenarios.acceptance: The replay does not duplicate credit or output state.

scenarios.name: provider callback loss and bounded retry
scenarios.requirement: Missing callbacks consume a bounded retry budget and terminate in a dead letter.
scenarios.acceptance: No unbounded provider submissions occur.

scenarios.name: provider 429 retry classification
scenarios.requirement: Provider throttling is retryable without leaking the response body.
scenarios.acceptance: The error is sanitized and classified as retryable.

scenarios.name: provider 5xx retry classification
scenarios.requirement: Provider server failures use their bounded retry policy.
scenarios.acceptance: The error maps to the distinct provider 5xx policy.

scenarios.name: GPU out-of-memory fallback
scenarios.requirement: OOM creates one immutable reduced child without double charging.
scenarios.acceptance: One reduced child is created and the credit invariant holds.

scenarios.name: multipart provider acknowledgement loss
scenarios.requirement: Multipart completion recovers from acknowledgement loss and abort remains idempotent.
scenarios.acceptance: Recovery creates no duplicate document and abort is safe to replay.

scenarios.name: expired multipart ownership and URL
scenarios.requirement: Expired upload ownership and stale signed URLs fail closed.
scenarios.acceptance: Expired ownership cannot finalize or disclose an upload.

scenarios.name: partial deletion retry
scenarios.requirement: Partial deletion preserves the manifest, cancels work, and releases credit once.
scenarios.acceptance: Retry finishes the same receipt without duplicate release.

scenarios.name: Redis limiter outage
scenarios.requirement: The distributed abuse limiter fails closed when Redis is unavailable.
scenarios.acceptance: The protected operation is not admitted during limiter uncertainty.

scenarios.name: model endpoint rollback
scenarios.requirement: Promotion, rollback, and retirement are atomic and audited.
scenarios.acceptance: Rollback restores the prior binding and every transition is audited.

scenarios.name: signed payment webhook clock skew
scenarios.requirement: Webhook timestamps outside the five-minute replay window are rejected.
scenarios.acceptance: Expired and replayed signatures are rejected.

scenarios.name: local API restart
scenarios.requirement: The local API can be paused and resumed with bounded health recovery.
scenarios.acceptance: Health returns within the configured recovery window.

scenarios.name: local PostgreSQL restart
scenarios.requirement: The local database can be paused and resumed without an unsafe target.
scenarios.acceptance: Readiness recovers and the drill emits a non-deployment evidence receipt.

scenarios.name: one thousand concurrent SSE clients
scenarios.requirement: A nonproduction deployment sustains 1,000 reconnecting SSE clients.
scenarios.acceptance: Connection success >= 99.5%, duplicate reduction remains exact, p95 reconnect <= 5 s.

scenarios.name: one hundred concurrent uploads
scenarios.requirement: A disposable nonproduction tenant sustains 100 concurrent direct uploads.
scenarios.acceptance: HTTP failure < 1%, no orphaned multipart uploads, no duplicate documents.

scenarios.name: ten-thousand-page enqueue
scenarios.requirement: A preapproved synthetic 10,000-page fixture is admitted without request-thread processing.
scenarios.acceptance: Enqueue returns within 2 s, processing is asynchronous, memory stays within deployment limits.

scenarios.name: mixed-size fairness soak
scenarios.requirement: Small jobs from another tenant are not starved by large jobs.
scenarios.acceptance: No tenant exceeds configured scheduler share and small-job p95 wait stays within the release budget.

scenarios.name: export burst
scenarios.requirement: Concurrent exports remain isolated and bounded.
scenarios.acceptance: No cross-tenant object access, duplicate charge, or orphaned export.

scenarios.name: five-thousand-file collection manifest
scenarios.requirement: A disposable collection admits exactly 5,000 synthetic file records without request-thread file processing.
scenarios.acceptance: The exact 5,000-file manifest is content-addressed, bounded, and deleted after the observation.

scenarios.name: ten-GiB interrupted collection resume
scenarios.requirement: A ten-file 10 GiB synthetic collection pauses after 5 GiB and resumes in a new client process.
scenarios.acceptance: Exactly 10 GiB completes after token rotation with no duplicate document or orphaned multipart upload.

scenarios.name: thirty-thousand-page preflight
scenarios.requirement: An attested synthetic collection with exactly 30,000 known pages completes fast and precise preflight within the v4 budgets.
scenarios.acceptance: Fast estimate is at most 120 seconds, precise estimate is at most 900 seconds, and 30,000 pages are observed.

scenarios.name: one-thousand-page processing UI
scenarios.requirement: The real processing workspace exposes an attested 1,000-page dataset through the readiness evidence interface.
scenarios.acceptance: Readiness, heap, DOM, and long-task thresholds pass without rendering an unbounded page list.

scenarios.name: ten-thousand-block workspace
scenarios.requirement: The real workspace exposes an attested 10,000-block dataset through the readiness evidence interface.
scenarios.acceptance: Readiness, heap, DOM, and long-task thresholds pass without rendering all blocks at once.

scenarios.name: five-thousand-node graph
scenarios.requirement: The real graph workspace exposes an attested 5,000-node dataset through the readiness evidence interface.
scenarios.acceptance: Readiness, heap, DOM, and long-task thresholds pass with bounded rendered graph state.
